# E05 build plan

The design is greenlit with zero blockers. This plan implements its five cold-review majors without reopening the design review (docs/tdd/reviews/E05.astra-c1.md:1). Implementation acceptance still requires the pending shared contracts; a disabled integration is not a passed requirement (docs/requests/E05.md:1).

Only this directory is edited by the supervisor. The exact coder ownership, standalone briefs and commands are in [tasks.json](tasks.json). No coder is dispatched by this planning handoff. Gates below are implementation obligations, not results already obtained.

## Repository and ownership

At inspection, hub/, ui/ and eval/ do not exist. contracts/ and config/ contain only pharmacy files; fixtures/ contains only the pharmacy fixture. Generated API models, the UI workspace, E01 kernel.testing, scripts/validate_hub.py and fixtures/demo-mara-fd19 are not delivered. scripts/validate_contracts.py belongs to the engine and is not a substitute hub gate (docs/SYSTEM.md:1623).

Current other build manifests are docs/build/E02/tasks.json, docs/build/E03/tasks.json, docs/build/E07/tasks.json, docs/build/E08/tasks.json, docs/build/E09/tasks.json, docs/build/E10/tasks.json, docs/build/E14/tasks.json and docs/build/E21/tasks.json. Their owned paths do not overlap E05. Other designs reserve distinct modules; E03 owns MeasurementCard, E27 KitCheckLine, E28 GapCard, E30 teach and E21 the shared harness/fixture. E05 owns none of their files (docs/tdd/E05.md:603, docs/SYSTEM.md:141). Recheck ownership before dispatch because plans may arrive concurrently. All 28 implementation files reserved by E05 section 13 are allocated once, with no shared-directory claims.

## Build order and connections

| Task | Owned concern | Dependencies and release condition |
|---|---|---|
| T1 | Pure model, approved ports, capability/request/gap reads, common test setup | E01 kernel/generated contracts and approved R-E05-1/5/7 bindings for affected reads. Publish the local domain/repository interface once |
| T2 | Six measurement tables, repository, additive migration, storage faults | T1; real E01 UOW/platform. Repository tests require no T3 commands |
| T3 | Commands, atomic record linkage, acquisition and recovery | T1/T2; approved R-E05-1/2/3/4/5/6. Providers can initially be documented port fakes |
| T4 | Four Vue components and component tests | Parallel with T1; E01 generated client, E03 toolchain/components and R-E05-4 copy/UI bindings. No dependency on T3 implementation for component tests |
| T5 | Router, module registration, boundaries and real-stack acceptance | T3/T4; all real providers needed by each scenario and E21 harness/fixture. Return fixes to their file owner |

Start independent tasks as soon as their listed inputs exist. E01/E02 are hard dependencies; the rest add capability per SYSTEM sections 9/10. Optional providers may be absent in fallback tests. A fake cannot settle an unpublished protocol or replace real-provider acceptance (docs/SYSTEM.md:2338).

The module plugs into E01 through register(ModuleRegistry), not a central assembly edit. T1 declares approved ports; T2 writes only measurement tables through StorageSession; T3 joins caller UOWs and the shared task runner; T5 exposes the five contracted operations. T4 consumes the generated client. E01 owns observations, E02 current grants, E11 request eligibility, E27 kit calculation, E15 episode state, E23 environment and E28 alternatives. Public measurement_request.changed follows commit; approved internal events join the producer transaction (docs/tdd/E05.md:98,233,316,350; docs/SYSTEM.md:1552).

## Cold-review implementation obligations

| Comment | Exact settlement and evidence owner |
|---|---|
| 1: revision omissions | T1/T2/T3 increment once for every committed representation change, including start/cancel and terminal late-attempt append without a state change. Exact duplicates do not increment. T5 asserts GET ETag, event revision and concurrent If-Match behavior |
| 2: resolved episode | T3 authorizes/binds the episode, inserts the request and publishes the approved internal change in one producer UOW. E15 creates the new link and reopens with new_activity in that UOW. Reject unknown/unauthorized episodes, not resolved ones. T5 proves atomic commit and rollback from a resolved episode. No prerequisite reopen HTTP call (docs/tdd/E15.md:265,509,1071) |
| 3: E30 protocol | T3 reads the existing E30 design. Its guided_check_id/attempt_no reference window is not an E05 acquisition identity. The binding proposal below must be agreed before integration; no legacy E30 kernel imports or inferred acceptance. Manual capture survives camera absence (docs/tdd/E30.md:448,533) |
| 4: V87 | T3 preserves E01 manual provenance; E30 owns unchecked presentation; E12/E13 exclude support. T5 drives camera NO_READING and verifies retained count, unchecked UI, support exclusion and open ECG gap. Counterparts: T30-04, T30-05, T30-09, T-E12-022 and T-E13-041, T-E13-042 (docs/tdd/E30.md:1070, docs/tdd/E12.md:521, docs/tdd/E13.md:862) |
| 5: branch gate | T5 measures domain/application only and requires E01's safety gate to count branches independently. A regression with 90 covered statements and 6/10 covered branches must fail. Missing branch data/files fail. Keep full-condition and mutation gates; combined pytest-cov percentage alone cannot greenlight |

The older conformance findings remain covered: E12 effects join E13's apply UOW, device/band workers wait for named bounds, and import-linter uses its generated configuration (docs/tdd/reviews/E05.conformance.md:100). No new design-review round is planned.

## End-to-end evidence

T5 owns every case below in eval/scenarios/E05/test_measurement.py. HTTP runs through the real composition root with real temporary SQLite, authentication, configuration, repositories, audit, ledger and outbox. Browser cases use Playwright against the running hub through E21's harness. No mocks inside the hub. External model/device/link adapters may be their documented fakes or absent; fake results cannot claim real LIVE acquisition. Fixtures load explicitly through E21's demo profile; completed API examples are never seeded as implementation state. Missing scenario/provider fails acceptance, never skip/xfail (docs/tdd/E05.md:549,573; docs/product/VALIDATION.md:20).

| Traces | What the real-stack case proves |
|---|---|
| V05, V11, D08, D11; T-E05-04, T-E05-14, T-E05-15 | Partial pulse with failed breathing, absent device and failed first attempt retain truthful reasons/history; no failed value or ID becomes assessment support |
| V07, V08, V09, D09; T-E05-03, T-E05-14 | Unpaired station denied; selector retains conflict and method/device attribution; LIVE presenter stays separate from SIM Mara and changes neither Mara baseline nor participation. Automated recorded-source evidence is separate from mandatory live-camera evidence |
| V13; T-E05-05 | Cancel before/after dispatch and racing result commit; logical cancel distinct from stopped/cannot_stop/unknown; late real input quarantined, retained and usable only after approved explicit review |
| V14, V15; T-E05-06, T-E05-07 | Old input keeps observed time, ambiguous units held for correction; clock segment reset, mission boundary and forward/backward correction never make old evidence current |
| V16, V35, R25; T-E05-08 | Retry, changed target, duplicate sequence, process death at command/commit/worker receipt boundaries and disk full produce no lost accepted record or duplicate start; UI/event cursor and revision recover |
| V17; T-E05-01 | Sourced microgravity applicability blocks a standing test, with honest gap/review |
| V18, V19, V20, V28, V78, D06, D12, D30; T-E05-02, T-E05-15 | Real kit gate accepts supported pulse and commits unavailable ECG/eye/dosimeter requests with gap/form links before refusal; no task, false diagnosis or fabricated dose. Alternatives and ring remain honest. Also test no-episode audit and atomic resolved-episode reopening |
| V23, V25, V34; T-E05-03, T-E05-04, T-E05-12, T-E05-15 | Real tools/controller reject nonexistent, failed, cross-patient and fictitious lab support; cancelled/stale proposals leave no effects; assistant cannot accept/start or mutate safety |
| V36; T-E05-11 | Real browser keyboard-only request/manual flow; failures and unknowns intelligible without color; urgent navigation remains reachable |
| V69; T-E05-10 | Full injected mission day with model/devices/ground/tablets absent: laptop manual capture, fixed help, checks/routine/warnings/records/sharing through their real owners, no insight. Missing gate provider blocks acquisition while independent care remains usable |
| V75; T-E05-09 | Scratch configuration label/threshold/step/environment changes reach API/UI with no code change; old work and warnings keep pins; corrupt activation retains last good release. No safety mapping edit |
| V85, V86, V87; T-E05-14 | Agree retains attributed manual observation; disagree retains both sources and incomplete retry with no success award; no camera retains count labeled unchecked and excluded from support. No gap closure, diagnostic exclusion or clinical drill writes |

This covers every E05 V/D row, E05-01/02/03, R06/R07/R08 and its R25 contribution (docs/tdd/E05.md:9,573). The same cases exercise charter section 6 critical paths: freshness/no fabrication, unauthorized action/privacy denial, durable capture/retry, configuration change, independent help/manual care and no assistant safety change. T5 also verifies canaries on each active exit after revocation/outage, no routine/participation change from readings, approved-summary delivery after outage through E16/E29, and help latency under recovery/acquisition load. Disabled measurement replication remains an explicit open dependency, not a tested export implementation.

## Gates and hand-in

Each task lists exact owned-test, lint and type commands. Python uses uv --project hub and explicit hub pytest configuration to avoid the engine's root settings; UI uses pnpm. Import contracts are generated into a per-invocation temporary file before lint-imports, preventing concurrent gate artifact collisions (docs/SYSTEM.md:1661,1677; docs/tdd/E03.md:998).

T5 reruns all measurement tests and all eval cases with branch instrumentation limited to measurement.domain/application, then scripts/validate_hub.py interfaces generated trace safety and mutations. The safety command must implement the separate branch check requested below. Full hub and UI suites, generated contract guards, full-condition safety checks, complexity <=15 and independent build review remain required (docs/tdd/E01.md:727; docs/tdd/E05.md:670). A missing command, provider, scenario or gate is reported blocked, never made green through filters or fallback assertions. Hardware and performance results, CI and AI-use rows are separate required evidence; this planning run claims none of them.

Planning verification: JSON/schema-shape checks, the dependency DAG, all read paths, complete E05 section 13 allocation, cross-plan ownership and prohibited-dash scans passed. The independent read-only plan reviewer returned GREENLIGHT with no blockers or majors, confirming the five review obligations, all V/D rows, non-circular task handoffs and the branch-gate prerequisite. No implementation, hardware or CI gate ran because the required code/toolchains are absent. The coordinator must retain this review evidence in the authorized review log.

## Requests

Addressed to the coordinator. The edit restriction forbids changes to docs/requests/E05.md or the design. These are concrete handoffs for Sol/the relevant owners to publish there and in their contracts before affected coders proceed, not newly accepted shared interfaces.

1. **Dispose R-E05-1 through R-E05-8 with provider owners.** Publish complete typed DTOs, caller snapshots/pins, transaction ownership, error declarations and tests. R-E05-1 includes E15 new-link reopening above, not a prerequisite reopen; R-E05-2 trusted proof/manual linkage/physical receipts; R-E05-3 lifecycle/review; R-E05-4 minimal projections/method selection/copy; R-E05-5 sourced applicability/quality; R-E05-6 bounds and reserved result capacity; R-E05-7 authorized gap reads/addressing; R-E05-8 measurement export. No repeated request for settled SYSTEM mechanisms. Existing interims remain binding, acceptance open (docs/requests/E05.md:7).
2. **Sol, E01/E02/E05/E06/E30: extend R-E05-2 with the existing guided-window lifecycle.** Proposed semantics: E30 acceptance authorizes its own guided check and manual operator only. Persist the exact guided_check_id, attempt_no, record_id, window_start/window_end and required_origin relationship from ReferenceWindowRequest. Bind any optional E05 acquisition by an explicit persisted relationship to its request_id/acquisition_id/generation and separately validated E05 acceptance, subject/operator/mission/origin and release. Never derive an E05 request or acceptance from a camera ticket. E30's manual finish writes through E01 in its producer UOW independently of camera outcome. E06 reference tickets retain the guided identity; cancellation/abandon revokes automatic publication, not durable real evidence. Authenticated late clinical input retains original provenance in the approved quarantine path; drills with persist=False retain no clinical record. E30 cancellation is not an E05 cancel command; fence only the explicitly linked binding under the approved joint protocol. Publish exact proof/transport DTOs and cancellation/evidence acknowledgment ownership before enabling the bridge. Replace stale kernel signatures in E30 through its owner, never compatibility aliases in E05. This settles review comment 3 while preserving manual no-reference capture (docs/tdd/E30.md:448,464,533; docs/requests/E05.md:59).
3. **E01 gate owner: implement comment 5 in the existing safety gate.** The command uv run --project hub python scripts/validate_hub.py interfaces generated trace safety must reject branch coverage below 95% in measurement domain/application separately from statement and adapter counts. Require fresh coverage data with the complete source inventory and report branch numerator/denominator; absent data/files fail. Add the 90-statement, 6/10-branch regression and a passing boundary case in E01-owned tests. Preserve full-condition, complexity and mutation checks. Until demonstrated, T5 cannot pass this gate (docs/tdd/E01.md:727; docs/tdd/reviews/E05.astra-c1.md:23).
4. **E01/E03/E21 and provider owners: deliver shared build/test/UI inputs.** Supply the documented kernel fakes, generated client, standalone toolchain, composition entry point, fault hooks, source release and explicit demo fixture/harness. Reuse E21 T2/T3/T5 launcher, explicit seed and Python Playwright driver (docs/build/E21/tasks.json). E01 must make the agreed runner/plugin and browser dependencies available to the documented hub eval commands; absent toolchain integration blocks them. No E05 test-configuration or spec-file invention. E03 mounts the E05 components through its existing ownership; E03/E27/E28 publish UI component bindings and R-E05-4 words. E12/E13/E30 provide T-E12-022, T-E13-041, T-E13-042 and T30-04, T30-05, T30-09 integration counterparts including NO_READING, unchecked display and support exclusion. Remaining absent producer designs/bindings must be supplied by their owners (docs/SYSTEM.md:2388; docs/tdd/E05.md:603).
5. **Coordinator: record AI use and review evidence.** Add this planning run and any independent plan-review run to AI-USE-LOG.md, and later each coder/reviewer run. The supervisor cannot edit that file. Retain build review findings/responses in the authorized review paths with owner approval; zero blockers ends review, and majors/minors are fixed without starting another round (AGENTS.md:143).
